title: Uni Mediterranean Skillet
description: A flavorful and nutritious skillet dish packed with uni, golden vegetables, and a hint of Mediterranean spices. Serve as a light dinner or snack with whole grain bread.
instructions: 1. Heat skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
3. Add sliced golden bell pepper and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
4. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
5. Add dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to taste.
6. Add uni and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
7. Continue to cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the uni is heated through.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
